description:
Merge Flowers is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game! Grow your vibrant garden, discover unique flowers, and earn coins. Enjoy merge puzzle and match-3 mechanics as you combine flowers to create a blooming paradise.
With simple controls and cozy visuals, place flowers strategically to make space for new plants. Perfect for puzzle lovers and fans of casual idle games, Merge Flowers offers endless fun and a soothing experience. Start your floral journey today!

title: Math King - Math Skill Game
description:
Math King is the perfect game to help your kids to improve their Math skills in easy & fun way!
This game even helps you to develop calculation speed with high accuracy!

description: Welcome to BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits game. Princesses Elsa, Anna, Moana, and Jasmine are more fascinated about Kawaii Outfits. They are very eager to browse the new collection of Kawaii outfits. Start helping with each princess for their outfits and matching costumes by browsing their wardrobe. Play these cute girl games and have fun!

title: Animal Swipe
description: Animal Swipe is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players match adorable animal pairs on a colorful board. With easy-to-learn controls and exciting power-ups, the game offers a challenge for both casual and strategic players. Use your wits and boosts to clear levels and achieve your objectives!

title: Lumber Factory Simulator
description:
Welcome to "Lumber Mill Simulator"! This is an exciting game where you own a sawmill.
Your success depends on your ability to make informed decisions, effectively manage resources and grow your business. Are you ready to become a great lumber tycoon?

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Spin Thru
description:
Fit the piece perfectly before the hole arrives!
Tap to rotate! Swipe left or right to flip!
When it’s ready, swipe up to send it through the hole.
Keep succeeding in a row to trigger Fever!
During Fever, easier puzzles will appear for a limited time!

title: Plane Chase
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

title: Hero Tower War
description:
Many monsters and enemies in the tower. You need to defeat them, get treasures and save hostages.

You can play everywhere ,every time. It is a boring killer game.

title: Teacher Simulator
description: Teacher Simulator is a fun simulation game in which you play the role of a teacher. Mark exams and ensure the kids are on their best behavior. You may have been the student, but now you get to be the one in charge!

title: Robby The Lava Tsunami
description:
In this game, you have to get to the finish line and not get caught in the lava tsunami. The game is similar to the popular mode from roblox, but there are unique abilities waiting for you. Use them to be better than your opponents.
This is a game for fans of jumping, speed, parkour.
The game has many skins for your character, and you can also buy a fashionable hat.

title: Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas
description: Step into the world of ‘Celebrities Get Ready for Christmas’! Join your favorite stars as they prepare for the festive season. Explore dazzling holiday outfits, glamorous decorations, and witness the magic of Christmas through the eyes of celebrities. Get ready for a star-studded holiday celebration! Play and have fun!

title: Capybara Block Drop
description:
Capybara Block Drop is a fast-paced, brain-teasing puzzle game where merging numbers and staying calm under pressure is the key to survival.

Drop numbered blocks into columns, combine matching tiles, and clear space with big combos.
But watch out, if the board fills up, it’s game over, and your capybara buddy might just lose his cool!

With colorful visuals and satisfying number-merging mechanics, Capybara Block Drop delivers endless strategic fun wrapped in a charming, lighthearted package.

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description: MineTap Merge Clicker is an idle clicker that combines merge mechanics with crafting and adventure. Dive into a pixelated world where you mine resources, craft powerful gear, and battle zombies and other monsters.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Popcat Clicker
description:
Popcat Clicker is a fun idle clicker game where you tap a cute cat to earn coins, unlock upgrades, boost your income, and progress through different levels. 
The more you tap, the faster your cat grows and the more rewards you earn.
Simple, addictive and perfect for all ages!

title: TapKO
description: One-tap fighter game. From the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride, get ready to rumble with TapKO - the knockout idle game that packs a punch! Jab, bob, and weave your way to the top, and train your fighter to become the ultimate boxer.

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Get To The Chopper
description: Gear up and fight your way to safety in Get To The Chopper, a thrilling 3D first-person shooter where every mission is a battle for survival! Your objective is clear: reach the extraction chopper while eliminating all enemies standing in your way. Armed with a fully customizable loadout—including a primary gun, secondary weapon, grenades, and a melee weapon—you’ll face waves of enemies across dynamic battlefields such as forests, deserts, and more.

title: Javelin Battle
description: Javelin Battle is a spear-throwing physics puzzle game with 2D stickman models. We need you to eliminate all incoming enemies at each level in the Normal Mode. When you destroy enemy infantry's shields, they will run to you quickly. I strongly suggest you destroy the enemy spearmen on the platforms first. Don't forget to choose skills to increase your abilities and power. Keep calm and aim carefully.

title: Save my Hero
description:
Players may enjoy a unique gaming experience in Save my Hero Online, an engaging puzzle game that revolves on drawing lines. You take on the role of a superhero under assault from missiles in the game. It is your responsibility to create lines to stop these projectiles and shield the hero.

Finish every level and attempt to rescue the superheroes, such as Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, and so on.

title: Draw And Escape
description: Car Games: Draw And Escape is a collection of parking puzzle games and drawing puzzle games. Draw Bridge requires you to draw a line across a defined area to help the yellow car to the finish line. When you meet the steps, you can also draw bridges to build a track to the finish line. Use your creativity to design the perfect path to win! Parking Jam 2d requires you to help all cars out of the parking lot smoothly and pay attention to the order of cars, to prevent traffic accidents.

title: Monster High Spooky Fashion
description: In Monster High Spooky Fashion, step into the world of ghouls and ghosts as you style your favorite Monster High characters! Choose spooky outfits, eerie accessories, and haunting makeup to create the ultimate creepy-cool look. Mix and match from a wide range of outfits to give each character a unique spooky style perfect for any Monster High event. Whether it’s for a Halloween party or a night out in the graveyard, bring out your inner fashionista with Halloween Spooky Fashion!

title: ASMR Beauty Clinic
description: Ready to become the star of the ASMR Beauty Clinic? Help your adorable clients look and feel their best with fun beauty and care treatments! Trim and treat damaged nails, heal sore fingers, and create fabulous nail art designs. Clean plaque from teeth, remove stains, and bring back sparkling smiles. Pop pesky pimples, clean up skin, and give relaxing facial treatments for a fresh new look. Don't forget the eyes. Remove dirt, treat styes, and help your patients see clearly again!

title: Code Runner: Binary Confusion
description: A fast-paced binary runner where logic and reflexes collide. Match the rule, dodge the wrong digit — survive the code! .A psychological runner puzzle where every second counts and one rule could change everything.

title: Warfare 1942 - online shooter
description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II, where every battle is a unique fight for survival!
The game is designed for military enthusiasts and those who love intense online battles. It’s the perfect choice for players who prefer shooters with detailed gameplay, a variety of characters, and customization. Suitable for both seasoned fighters and newcomers.

title: Magic Bubbles
description: Quick games, satisfying pops and constant rewards — what’s not to love? Enjoy a bubble shooter built for endless play, with weekly bonuses, boosters that change the game and the Lucky Wheel for a little extra fun. There’s always something new to pop.

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Traitor Beaver!
description: Beaver Traitor! An exciting game where one player takes on the role of the traitor, while the other players act as regular participants. Your goal as the traitor is to secretly kill all the other players, sabotaging their tasks at the nuclear power plant. You'll need to be cunning, careful, and think strategically to avoid detection and achieve victory. Use various tactics and deception to reach your goals.

title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
description: Your goal is simple: guide the snake through tangled grids and help it escape without getting stuck. Each level challenges you to think ahead, choose the right order, and find safe paths through tight spaces. Blending classic snake mechanics with modern puzzle escape logic, every maze feels handcrafted — clean, clever, and satisfying to solve.

title: Snake Hunter
description:
"Snake Hunter" – Giant serpents are invading our homeland! Grab your weapons, fortify our defenses, and slay the monstrous snakes to protect our land.

In this game, you play as a guardian, battling each segment of the serpent's massive body. Collect skills and upgrade buffs dropped by the snakes to enhance your weapon's power and abilities. As you face different serpents across various levels, you'll need to strategically choose skills to counter their attacks and emerge victorious.

title: Geometry Vibes 3D
description: Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Tiles of the Unexpected 2
description:
Tiles of the Unexpected 2 is a puzzle game with a dark military theme and refined gameplay. Clear groups of tiles, set off chain reactions, and plan each move carefully as the board shifts and collapses. The classic mechanics from Tiles of the Unexpected return with smoother controls and a sharper, more intense style.

The game introduces a new Time Attack mode, where speed and strategy are key. Clear tiles quickly to push back enemy forces and survive as long as possible.

title: TimeWarriors

Command your vessel and level up by collecting valuable crates and sinking enemy ships, gaining power and upgrades as you rise.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

Welcome to Fortune's Deck Solitaire, where ancient Tarot magic meets the timeless thrill of Tripeaks!

Three enchanted towers of fate await your touch - draw from the mystical deck and begin your journey through the arcana.

Inspired by the classic Tripeaks Solitaire, this magical twist invites you to clear the cards, trust your intuition, and let the deck reveal your fortune.

Will you find insight, mystery… or unexpected luck?

Your objective? Strategically rotate your tethered pair to completely coat all target cylinders in each level.

In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

Start your engines and hit the track now!

description: Void Orbit is an addictive space arcade game where you orbit a central core and dodge incoming enemies. Tap to reverse direction and survive as long as possible! Unlock cool skins, dynamic themes, enjoy challenging modes like Echo Mirage and Tower Build. Multi-language support for global players. Free to play, endless fun!

description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls
description: 2048 Run: Gorgeous Balls is a fun arcade game that invites you to chase high scores in a delightful environment! In this creative 2048-style game, you’ll control a colorful array of balls as they race along a dynamic track.

title: Amazing Airplane Racer
description: Amazing Airplane Racer revolutionizes the airborne gaming experience by combining high-speed plane racing with strategic special skills. Maneuver through challenging tracks while collecting power-ups like turbo boosts and shields to outsmart opponents. With stunning graphics and intense multiplayer action, the game delivers an adrenaline-packed aerial competition where skill and strategy take center stage. Are you ready to dominate the skies and become the ultimate airborne champion?

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Wood Block Puzzle 3
description: Wood Block Puzzle 3 is a polished, relaxing 10×10 wooden block game featuring a fresh UI, smart boosters, and satisfying break animations. Drag shapes from the right tray, complete rows or columns to score, and chase your best record. Use boosters at the bottom—watch rewarded ads to earn coins and unlock boosters when needed. Simple to learn and hard to master, it’s perfect for quick breaks or long zen sessions.

title: Tile Match Connect 3 Tiles
description:
You have to tap and match all the tiles to clear the playing field before the timer expires. It can help you focus and hone your skills to think and react quickly. Go to the unearthly world and become a master of the match 3 game genre!

Enjoy this mahjong tile matching game and enjoy moments of peace during the day to calm your mind and recharge your brain. Sharpen your mind with a series of tile matching levels that gradually increase the difficulty of the puzzle. Relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery backgrounds and use your creativity to decorate your own zen room to relax!

Let matching tiles become your new hobby for a relaxed creative mind. Come back to it every day, as there are always new daily mahjong puzzles that allow you to take care of your own houseplant and become a mahjong master!

title: Trolley fun
description: Trains connect cities and carry goods, but bandits are constantly attacking them! Collect resources, upgrade your train to repel all attacks!

title: Princess vs Shark
description:
Dive into a magical underwater world with “Princess vs Shark”!
Game Features:
	•	Engaging Gameplay: Solve puzzles, guide water flows, and help the princess overcome obstacles.
	•	Beautiful Graphics: Immerse yourself in the enchanting underwater world.
	•	Challenging Levels: Each level gets harder and more thrilling!

description: Let's go on to ride with an oil tanker transporter truck across all the continents like the Euro, Asia, and America oil transporter truck game has real features in the Euro and American cargo systems of the fuel truck.

title: Rush Car Driving - Race Master
description:
Rush Car Driving: Race Master is a driving game that delivers thrilling action as you navigate heavy traffic. 

Experience the adrenaline of high-speed racing in heavy traffic, where split-second decisions can be the difference between victory and defeat. Explore a variety of immersive environments, from busy urban highways to rural roads. 

Choose from a wide selection of cars, from sports cars to muscle machines. Buckle up and start the race!

title: Count and Bounce
description: Count And Bounce is a ball puzzle game. It guides the ball forward. Release your hand and the ball will keep moving forward. You need to turn the tiles to prevent the ball from falling. There will be calculation questions on some tiles and you need to choose the best tile to bounce based on the number of balls you have.  Have fun!

title: Clinic Cleanup Crew
description:
Players play the role of cleaners in the health center in the game. They are responsible for the cleaning and sanitation work in all areas within the health center, keeping the environment of the health center clean and hygienic and providing a good environment for clients.
The game features a fresh and lovely art style, with the details of characters and buildings depicted vividly, bringing players a healing visual enjoyment.

title: Mahjong Zen Garden
description:
Do you like relaxing games? Or do you prefer a challenge? Try Mahjong Zen Garden and choose the way you want to play!

*Hone your attention to detail and planning skills in this classic Chinese puzzle game by choosing the best mode for you.
*120 unique campaign levels!
*Show your skills and unlock Endless Mode!
*Unique design with an Eastern atmosphere!

title: Galaxy Control: 3D Strategy
description: Galaxy Control: 3D Strategy is a 3D space strategy game that puts you in command of epic battles and interstellar expansion. Build your base, defend your territory, and engage in thrilling conflicts with other players.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
description: Begin a fruity puzzle adventure. Princess Rescue Fruit Connect is a delightful match puzzle game where your mission is to rescue a beautiful princess by matching fruits and solving tricky levels. Connect two identical fruits to eliminate them. But notice clearing the board before time runs out. All while progressing to rescue the princess.

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
description: Experience a high-speed realistic car collision simulator! Drive down slopes and crash into specialized obstacles with various vehicles, all featuring authentic physics and a detailed damage system with separating parts.

title: My Little Car Wash
description: Wash and shine with My Little Car Wash, a 2D cartoon game that lets you clean different vehicles. You don’t need any experience, just follow the hints and use the tools to make the vehicles look new. You will have 22 vehicles to choose from, each with its dirt and stains. You will also have the drivers watching you as you work, so be quick and efficient. You will earn yellow stars for each vehicle you wash. My Little Car Wash is a game that will teach you some washing skills! Have fun!

title: Driver Master Simulator
description: Driver Master Simulator is a 3D vehicle driving game. In Truck Mode, your task is to swiftly transport animals to their destinations. All transport missions have tight time constraints. Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
description: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
description: Indulge in the Fashionista Christmas Eve Party extravaganza! Discover glamorous holiday ensembles, festive accessories, and the perfect blend of chic for a stylish celebration. Join the fashion-forward festivities and elevate your Christmas Eve style to new heights. Unwrap the magic of the season with Fashionista, where every outfit is a statement and every moment is a fashion triumph. Let the glamour of Christmas Eve unfold.

title: Zombie Monster Survivors
description: Zombie Monster Survivors is a role-playing game where you will become a brave survivor. Fight against terrifying zombies and monsters in an amazing world. Use your resources wisely and defeat the monsters and zombies that keep coming. Try to survive in this extreme environment. Keep moving and attack large waves of zombies. Collect coins or energy and choose your skills.

description: Planet Demolish is a fun simulation game. The universe is a mysterious existence. In the distant outer space, there are many asteroids. They reflect the light of the sun and are the stars we see in the night. Humans have discovered and named Mars, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, etc.

title: Gothic Knife
description: Test your skills in this classic knife-throwing arcade game. Your goal is to stick all knives into the rotating target without hitting the ones already there. The target spins faster and more unpredictably with each level. Every 3 levels, a unique boss battle awaits you! Master the combo system to get high scores and enjoy Gothic

description: Join a girl named Vika and the mayor of a magical city in their quest to bring back the holiday spirit and ensure a successful New Year! Play challenging match 3 levels by connecting elements and solving puzzles to overcome various obstacles and help the mayor overcome problems.

title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Pet Runner
description: Pet Runner is a fast-paced platformer where your pet runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Play in Endless Mode for infinite fun or tackle unique challenges in Level Mode. Use up to three lives, hit checkpoints, and complete daily challenges to earn coins. Unlock and customize adorable pets in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Pet Runner offers fun for all ages!

title: Circuit Master
description: Circuit Master is a puzzle game where you aim to get a green light by connecting the circuit correctly! Arrange the wires, fans, and machines in the right places, then turn on the button to see the electricity flow. Only the correctly connected circuit will make the green light shine. Use hints if you need help.

title: Happy Jump
description: Bounce into blissful heights with Happy Jump! Guide the cute chicken on its springy pogo to leap skyward amid lush trees and fun obstacles. Smash your personal best, snag stars, and chase trophies in this addictive, one-tap thrill. Endless jumps, soaring scores—pure joy awaits!

title: Puzzle About Orange
description: Test your mind in Orange Puzzle Quest, a fun fruit puzzle game packed with logic challenges and brain teasers! Match colors, solve tricky levels, and enjoy juicy orange adventures. Perfect for US students searching “puzzle game,” “fruit puzzle,” or “brain puzzle,” this addictive casual game mixes fun with strategy. Can you conquer every orange puzzle and prove your skills? Play now and boost your brainpower while having endless fun!

description: Monsters from minecraft are trained at the monster school by Herobrin's teacher. Take the tests, find out who is a Noob and who is a real pro in Bottle Flip challenge, parkour and roller coaster!

title: Dragon Hunter
description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.
Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: Komaru cat

Style Anna’s outfits and bring her fairy tale story to life!

As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

In this engaging online game, you'll manage and grow a network of gyms—upgrade your facilities, invest in top-notch equipment, and fine-tune every detail to run smoothly. Whether you're playing on your phone or computer, dive into a game where strategy meets a passion for health. With dynamic gameplay, you'll turn a small operation into a booming fitness brand.

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

Have you ever dreamt of becoming a fashionable DIY make-up stylist in the beauty makeup artist’s salon?

You can showcase your skills as a make-up stylist in our salon. Make use of various tools and facial cleansers to give your model a refreshing skin makeover. Compete for high scores, enjoy colorful visuals, and master the puzzle. Play now and prove you’re the champion!

description:
Magic Finger Puzzle 3D is an interesting casual puzzle online game. You have an amazing pair of  hands that can fire the laser. It can help you smash the cages that are holding you. It can also
  launch boxes onto barricades so that you can escape from the cage without stepping on spikes and dying. But don't worry, you need to use your ingenuity to make good use of those amazing hands. All difficulties will be solved. Join the game if you want to try a journey full of adventure.

title: Shell Strikers
description:
Shell Strikers is an exciting turn-based artillery combat game where strategy meets action. Lead your team of soldiers in intense battles across diverse battlefields including war-torn cities, scorching deserts, and peaceful meadows.

Each turn, you must carefully aim your shots, account for wind conditions, and choose the right weapon from your arsenal. Available weapons include rockets, bombs, laser guns, airstrikes, and dynamite - each with unique properties and limited ammo.

title: Gluttony
description: In Gluttony, you control a giant hole with endless appetite! Move around, swallow everything, and grow like in snake games or Hole.io. With fun challenges, addictive arcade action, and silly gameplay, Gluttony is the ultimate free kids game to play anytime.

Throw your sword at the monsters to defeat them all.

description: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park is a horror escape adventure where bright amusement park rides hide lurking dangers. Players must solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover clues while evading hostile enemies. Stealth and timing are crucial—explore cautiously, hide when needed, and outsmart the threats to survive and escape. The mix of colorful setting and eerie tension creates a unique, suspenseful experience.

title: 12 Minute Escape
description: Repair the ancient portal and escape before time runs out! Defeat slimes, gather magical resources, build powerful structures, unlock new wizard characters, and survive exciting world events. Every minute brings new opportunities with Golden Rush, Treasure Hunt, and Wizard Frenzy. Plan your upgrades wisely, grow stronger, and see if you can escape within 12 minutes! Beware the Slime King!

title: Passenger Sort
description: Play Passenger Sort free online and take control in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Guide travelers to the right buses, planes, and trains in a clever logic puzzle that works as a fun brain game for all ages. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart sorting challenges anytime.

title: Toy Claw Simulator
description: Toy Claw Simulator is a fun and addictive arcade game where you take control of a virtual claw machine to collect a wide variety of adorable toys! Carefully aim and time your claw to grab plushies, action figures, and surprise collectibles. Once you've stocked up your toy inventory, head over to the factory to sell them for shiny coins! Use your earnings to run the machine to use the crane to unlock new toys. It's a charming blend of skill, strategy, and rewarding progression!

title: Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop
description:
Take the classic bubble shooter to a new level! Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop features a rotating puzzle core that rewards smart aiming and chain reactions. 
Clear all bubbles to complete each level and earn up to 3 stars (10 pts per direct match, 20 pts for freed bubbles).
Beware the deadly Magma Vortex, and avoid fouls that add extra bubbles for missed matches!

title: SlitherCraft.io

title: Emoji Merge Fun Moji
description: Welcome to Emoji Merge: Fun Moji! A fun and creative jigsaw puzzle that allows you to merge various funny emojis. Create super funny, super cute emoji combinations. It's not just a simple merger game and full of interesting challenges.

title: Stick Hero Fight

This action game lets you upgrade your hero and unleash devastating attacks to dominate every fight! Use punches, weapons, and powerful skills to deliver deadly attacks.

title: Downtown Parkour Drive
description:
Downtown Parkour Drive is a fast-paced stunt driving game set in a wide open city training ground. Take control of a powerful sports car and push your driving skills to the limit as you complete a series of challenging parkour-style levels.

Each level is designed with ramps, platforms, and precision-based obstacles that require perfect timing and control. From simple jumps to complex stunt sequences, the difficulty increases as you progress through all 30 levels.

title: Pet Me Maze
description:
Welcome to Pet Me Maze, the most hilarious and addictive maze puzzle game that combines humor, challenge, and adorable pets
Are you ready to test your wits and reflexes in a maze full of surprises, traps, and funny moments

Experiment with gravity modes, from low to high or even zero gravity, and customize every detail, including debris levels, destructibility, and atmospheric dust. Built for fans of destruction, this game offers the smash-and-crash fun you've been craving!

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: Big Bad Ape

description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: Thread Match 2
description:
Thread Match 2 is a satisfying logic puzzle game that combines color matching, layered challenges, and calming embroidery visuals.

Solve clever thread puzzles by planning the correct order of moves and dismantling complex constructions. Each level challenges your brain with blocked and unlocked elements, where strategy and attention matter more than speed.

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Count Master Match Color Run
description: Count Master: Match Color Run is a colorful running game where you lead a group of little characters in a color-matching race! In this exciting arcade challenge, collect characters of the same color to grow your team. Merge them for a bigger squad, aiming for the highest score. Avoid hammers, spikes, etc. Collect characters of the same color to expand your team.

description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

description:
Race down massive slopes at high speed through stunning green plains, cliffs, and canyons!
In this thrilling arcade adventure, collect the mystical Crystal to save the world from an impending disaster.

title: Merge Sesame
description: This is a game anyone can easily learn and enjoy with the whole family!  With addictive sound effects and feedback, complete consecutive combos to relieve stress! If you hit a high combo with an object, your score will soar! There are no penalties or time limits, which means you can enjoy the game at your own pace. If you are looking for wonderful combination effects that are pleasing to the eye, join this game and challenge for the best score.

title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game where you clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Play a new puzzle every day, unlock missed days with ads, and keep your weekly streak for exciting rewards! Track your progress in the Weekly Record, where you can challenge yourself to beat your All-Time Best Score. Enjoy smooth gameplay, balanced difficulty from easy to hard, and use helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo to master every layout.

title: UGC Math Race

Run fast. Think faster!

Solve math problems on the go in this competitive racing game! Choose the correct answer to stay on track, one mistake and you fall.

Tap to move balls, merge the same numbers into bigger ones, and keep going to beat your best score. No time limits, no pressure — just pure fun. Perfect for fans of merge games, number games, and classic sort puzzles.

description: Take control of a giant cactus with an unusual hunger for meat! Roam the colorful 3D world, collecting meat from unsuspecting humans and free chunks scattered across the map. description: Meow Slide is a brain training puzzle, entertain your brain for minutes or hours with endless challenges. The Meow Slide puzzle is simple: slide blocks left or right to create and clear full lines.

Launch the sausage on the vine and keep moving to the next pot or shelf, etc. Use your perfect skills to master each tricky obstacle. Cross the finish line to win.

Each of the princesses is working on creating her own unique New Year's outfit, inspired by Hoffmann's mystical fairy tales and Tchaikovsky's classical ballet. Immersing themselves in the atmosphere of New Year's magic, players will be able not only to dress princesses, but also to develop their sense of style. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure and create your own New Year's image!

title: Jab Jab Boxing

Immerse yourself in fluid character animations, draw inspiration from over 200 motivational quotes and phrases, and sharpen your typing speed as you train to become the ultimate boxing champion.

title: Obby: Pump Up Your Muscles! 1 per second
description:
Welcome to the prison gym, where only strength earns respect!
You start as a skinny rookie, but every rep makes you stronger. Push-ups, sit-ups, pull-ups — build your body and rise through the ranks.

title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
description: Welcome to the second instalment of the popular Mahjong game that combines Solitaire Mahjong gameplay with the beautiful theme of the legendary Garden Tales match 3 game. Garden Tales Mahjong 2 features incredible 250+ puzzle layouts, 'Quick Play' mode for instant action, 'Chapters Mode' to unlock new puzzles. The more puzzles you complete the more puzzles you unlock. Enjoy this captivating journey and start your Garden Tales Mahjong adventure today!

title: Football Duel
description: Step into the arena in Football Duel! Take turns shooting and goalkeeping in this thrilling 3D penalty showdown. Swipe to score or defend — the first to 5 goals claims victory!

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

Jump over deadly spikes, pass through portals to shift themes, and survive as
the game speed increases over time.

The game is designed for short, replayable sessions with instant restarts.
Perfect for both desktop and mobile players.

description: Welcome to Bubble Blitz Galaxy! Aim and shoot bubbles towards similar ones to collect them while ensuring they stay away from the borderline. Experience two exciting modes: In Arcade Mode, strive to survive as long as possible and score as much as you can. In Challenge Mode, survive and achieve target scores, facing new challenges one after another. Get ready for an exhilarating bubble-blasting adventure!

Welcome to Evermatch puzzle game! Swipe colors, solve match-3 puzzles and play.
Victories in three-in-a-row allow you to unlock new locations and landmarks. Collect and check out the most beautiful countries of the world in one game!

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition

Are you ready for the challenge?

You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

Join Princess Bella on a magical adventure, matching jewels and crowns to uncover hidden treasures. Create powerful boosters like Royal Bombs, hammers, and arrows to clear obstacles and win big. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack bring the kingdom to life. Get ready for a royal journey full of fun and surprises!

title: Hidden Objects Crime Scene
description:
Keep clear! It's a police crime scene, and the evidence must not be disturbed. Engage your detective instincts and dive into Hidden Objects Crime Scene!
 
Keep a sharp eye out for clues left behind by the perpetrator. Work fast, and you might solve the case!

Can you find all the pieces of evidence? Come play now, and let's find out!

Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

Help the knight defeat enemies, avoid traps, and uncover hidden riches. Plan your moves carefully, as one wrong decision could cost you the treasure!

title: Mahjong At Home - Scandinavian Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the minimalist elegance of the North with 'Mahjong at Home: Scandinavian Winter Edition'. This high-quality Mahjong game celebrates the sleek, modern design of Scandinavian style, blending festive themes with clean, sophisticated aesthetics for a uniquely cozy winter gaming experience.

title: Hotfoot Baseball
description:
Simple baseball game with fun, cartoony players and easy one-click controls. It’s fast to learn and fun to play!

Unlike other baseball games, the action doesn’t stop after you hit the ball. You need to decide when to run, move to the next base, and try to score runs. It’s all about timing and quick decisions.

Pick one of the best baseball countries and try to win the championship. The game keeps the excitement of baseball but with simple rules, so anyone can enjoy it.

title: Through the Wall
description: Get ready for a unique puzzle experience with Through the Wall, where creativity and humor meet strategic problem-solving. Guide your stick figure character through moving walls by striking the perfect pose, with each level presenting new and exciting challenges.

title: Geometry Rush
description: Geometry Rush will take you to a world of challenging and treacherous platforming. Are you ready to run through trap-filled passages, jump and dodge death? Learn from your mistakes, perfect your reflexes, master the path without a single slip and advance to the next level.

title: War Of Gun
description: Experience the electrifying world of War Of Gun, an exhilarating first-person multiplayer shooter game. Take your shooting passion to the next level and immerse yourself in thrilling game modes like Raid, Deathmatch, Battle Royale, and Duels. Conquer territories and emerge victorious with stunning graphics and gripping gameplay. Join us now for an unbeatable gaming adventure!

title: 2048 Match Balls
description: With super simple rules and addictive gameplay, this logic game offers endless fun while challenging your brain. Merge balls and level up. Each merge increases the value of the balls while also changing their color and size. Be smart and dive into a vibrant world of numbers!

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Monster Squad Rush
description:
Assemble your squad of powerful monsters, evolve them into champions, and claim victory in the ultimate battle arena. Adventure, strategy, and competition await!

Whether you’re rushing through the course, collecting monsters, or battling for supremacy, Monster Squad Rush offers non-stop action and fun. Build your legacy as the ultimate monster trainer and conquer the arena today!

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: Ultimate Plants TD
description: Ultimate Plants TD is an army of plants to protect your garden from countless zombies. Your goal is to protect your garden from challenging waves of zombies. Experimenting with different plant combinations and positioning is the key to maximizing your defense capabilities and overcoming tough challenges!

title: Frogtastic Marble Adventure
description:
Get ready to dive into a world of colors and adrenaline with Frogtastic, the puzzle game that will keep you glued to the screen! Jump into the adventure and save your world from the invasion of colorful spheres by combining strategy and lightning-fast reflexes!

Endless fun! Whether you have a few minutes for a quick game or want to dive into long gaming sessions, Frogtastic is perfect for you.

Play now and experience a puzzle game you won’t forget!

title: Darts Jam
description:
This is a casual game of shooting balloons with darts.

When all the darts are pulled out, the board will also fall. When all the boards fall, the game is won.

The game is easy and simple to play, and the difficulty is getting stronger and stronger, which is challenging

title: Head Jump
description: run, jump, and climb to avoid direct collisions. Head Jump is a casual game, with a very fast runner forcing you to have a quick response to avoid obstacles, beautiful music will make you addicted to playing this game, difficult levels will stimulate tension and challenge adrenaline, complete each level to continue to improve your playing skills.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Extreme Real Car Driving 2025
description: This ultimate car racing 3D lets you experience real car driving simulator like highway racing with its realistic car damage, accurate car driving physics and many other features. Car driver may use steering wheel, accelerator meter or buttons to control the car. Enjoy the best car driving simulator game and drag racing game that has an addictive game play with endless fun. Now you can modify your any sports race cars from garage according to your interest.

title: Breakthrough Team
description: Begin an explosive adventure in Breakthrough Team, a thrilling mix of action, intense battle, and addictive tower defense gameplay. In this fast-paced game, you must build powerful defenses, deploy unique heroes, and command your team to break through waves of enemies.

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a sleek and minimal puzzle game where every move matters. Guide a one-eyed character through a grid to collect the key and reach the exit — but there’s a twist: once you start moving, you won’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. With simple mechanics and clean visuals, OUTSIDE is easy to pick up but tough to master — a perfect test of logic and spatial thinking.

title: Sniper for Brainrot
description: Use your sniper rifle to hit the balloon above a Brainrot, instantly transform into it, and race to the Safe Zone before a massive tsunami catches you. The farther you shoot, the rarer the Brainrot you can collect but the faster the wave becomes. Build your collection, expand your Base, unlock powerful sniper rifles, customize your character, and compete with friends in this addictive Brainrot adventure featuring 87 unique collectibles!

title: THE SURVEY
description:
After a long work time when you ready to play games in your computer and start a survey  and it's shows you the things that you don't want to watch and know!
- 5-10 min Gameplay
- Atmospheric Enveronment
- Intrective Gameplay

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Red Light Green Light
description: Step into the thrilling world of Red Light Green Light, a fast-paced and addictive game inspired by the classic playground challenge! Test your reflexes, strategy, and timing as you race against others to reach the finish line without getting caught.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: Guivo.io
description:
Challenge the world in Guivo.io, a skill-based Match-3 battle arena playable instantly in your browser! Match pieces, shatter ice and outscore opponents in lightning-fast 2-minute rounds.
Climb our chess-inspired Elo ranking system based solely on skill, earn Trophies with each victory and see your name showcased in the winner's banner. Ready to prove you're the puzzle master?

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Pet Merge
description:
Merge adorable pets! 
Combine cute companions to unlock rare and magical species. 
Pass exciting levels in adventure mode or beat your high score in the classic mode.
Let's Play! Meow

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: SHOT CAN WILD
description: Keep tapping to shoot and prevent the can from falling! The game ends when you run out of ammo. Hit the center of te target for a COOL SHOT! Chain COOL SHOT to restore ammo!

title: Mahjong Sort Puzzle
description: This is an addictive matching puzzle game. If you are a mahjong fan and love matching games, this game is for you. You need to sort out the mahjongs, sort out the mahjongs with the same colour into a grid and they will all be eliminated. While playing the game, you will also exercise your logical thinking and spatial sense. So, come and join the challenging world of gaming.

title: Zooma Dragon
description:
Zooma Dragon is a brand new and amazing zoom style game!
Complete all 300 levels! Try to get three stars in each level!
A bright adventure with colored balls awaits you!
Instead of a frog, you will play as a dragon.

title: Traffic Jam Hop On
description: In Traffic Jam: Hop On, challenge your strategy thinking and quick reflexes! This wonderful puzzle game will take you into a colorful parking lot. Your task is to help all kinds of vehicles get out of traffic jams and start smoothly.

title: Bubble Shooter Hawaii
description: Bubble Shooter Hawaii is a bubble shooter game with a hawaii theme and classic gameplay combined with special bubble mechanics. It's unique level map will guide you to the challenging levels with unique bubbles like the horizontal row destroyer, the rocks or the hidden bubbles.

title: Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle
description:
Step into the cozy world of Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle and let your mind unwind.
This calming puzzle game combines three favorite mechanics — Find, Sort, and Match — wrapped in a charming witchy atmosphere.

title: Castle Craft
description: Castle Craft is a mystical adventure puzzle game where you merge resources while looking for Fiona's missing husband, Michael, all the while uncovering plenty of mysteries along the way. Begin in a fog-covered land, using ancient keys to explore hidden realms and trace the path of your lost family through different eras.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Muscle Up Master
description: The aim of this game that will help you become a muscle master, a boxer or an MMA fighter is to reach the best level! In this adventure where you start with a weak body, start exercising and reach a more muscular body by merging with the characters. As you progress, participate in fighting tournaments and grow faster with the rewards you earn!

title: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon
description: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon is a relaxing and strategic idle game where players grow and manage their very own dairy business. Start by raising cows to produce milk, process raw milk then deliver the fresh milk packages to the market. Automate processes, upgrade your workers and warehouse to maximize efficiency and profits. Your goal is to build the ultimate dairy empire! Perfect for players who enjoy business simulation games.

title: Wipe Insight Master
description: Dop 3: Draw One Part is a free drawing online game for boys. Use your finger to draw and outline the shapes of the parts that the drawings need. Solve puzzles by using your powers of logic and lateral thinking as you work your way through a huge series of cute drawings that all have something a little bit wrong with them, it's up to you to work it out!

title: Craft Drill
description: Enjoy high-quality browser action in Craft Drill. Play online for free.

title: Cute Kitty Merge
description: Step into the role of a farmer and grow your own fruits and vegetables. In Solitaire TriPeaks Farming you will spend time in beautiful nature and play fun and constantly changing levels that will never allow for boredom. It is all about having fun.

title: Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up
description: Yakuzas have captured hidden treasures and ruins. Take action to save the places from the yakuza using your samurai skills! Fight with yakuza in different locations. Destroy the yakuza using the swords and weapons found in the boxes. The future of the kingdom is in your hands. Prepare for the fight now and save the kingdom!

title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
description: Get ready to navigate through the fast-paced world of healthcare, where every second counts. Your mission as a hyper nurse is to provide exceptional care to patients, manage critical situations, and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Get ready to put your multitasking skills to the test as you juggle multiple tasks and make crucial decisions in hyper nurse: hospital games.

title: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
description: Welcome to the game in which every new tide carries a new wave of style! Help two girlfriends to celebrate the new beach season with dignity. Each of the girls has her own unique sense of fashion and style. Combine swimsuits with a variety of accessories to create unique summer looks. And don't forget to pick up a surfboard or a sapboard. Get ready for adventures on the water and to become the most stylish on the whole coast!

title: World Cup Soccer Caps
description: World Cup Soccer Caps is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Atlantic Sky Hunter Xtreme
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey across the open Atlantic ocean in Atlantic Sky Hunter, an arcade endless shoot 'em up airplane game where you'll face off against challenging UFOs and formidable bosses, armed with an array of power-ups including spray bullets, extra health, and twin missiles; how high can you soar in this thrilling shmup adventure?

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Drawer Sort
description: Do you like a cluttered space exactly where everything has its place? It is time to organize your life and become a tidying hero, conquering chaos one drawer at a time.  Be sure to plan ahead for this epic puzzle or you may find yourself with a messier hand than when you started! Each brain training task will challenge you to place various items in the right places. You'll have to aim for perfect precision if you want to make sure the objects fit snugly and achieve the ultimate tidy victory.

title: Cube Speed Dash
description: Jump, dash, and survive in Cube Speed Dash, a high-speed arcade challenge where every second counts! Master lightning-fast reflexes as you guide a nimble cube through treacherous obstacle courses filled with spikes, traps, and deadly pitfalls. One wrong move—and it’s game over!

title: Foono Online Multiplayer
description: Foono Online Multiplayer is an engaging card game that takes inspiration from classics like Uno Online and Crazy Eights. The objective is to clear your hand of cards before your opponents do.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Ninja Spell Match
description: Ninja Spell Match is a fast-paced blend of match-3 puzzling and ninja action. Connect tiles to charge up your attacks and unleash devastating moves against waves of enemies. With each level, the challenge grows tougher as you fight your way through 30 unique stages packed with traps, puzzles, and rival ninjas. Think fast, match smart, and strike hard—your reflexes and strategy are the only way to survive.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Slide Block Puzzle
description: Slide Block Puzzle is an addictive puzzle game. With no timer or pressure, every move is a calming and satisfying challenge for your brain. Solve color block puzzles, arrange blocks to escape from challenging boxes, a game that provides a fun and satisfying experience.

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Number Merge 10
description: Number Merge 10 is a very innovative math puzzle game.Select a rectangular area, and if the sum of the numbers within that area equals 10, all the numbers in that area will be eliminated!

title: CrazyZombies 3D
description:
Crazy Zombies 3D is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter with cartoon-style 3D graphics. Use 10+ weapons to fight endless waves of zombies, conquer a town map, and unlock powerful upgrades. Battle 5 zombie types and 4 deadly bosses with unique abilities. Customize your loadout and survive as long as you can. Fun, intense, and addictive—can you survive the apocalypse?

?- Zombie Survival
?- 10+ Weapons to Master
?️- Conquer the Town
?- Boss Battles
?- Fun, Fast & Addictive

title: Teacher Simulator Christmas Exam
description: Welcome to the funniest and busiest Christmas classroom ever! Teacher Simulator: Christmas Exam is a charming and playful teacher class simulator where you act as a holiday teacher. Manage orders, hand out exam papers, grade tests, etc. Different classes are scheduled on different days of the week, such as art class, geography class, math class, and so on.

title: Mega Makeup - Seasons Best
description: Mega Makeup Seasons Best is the ultimate makeup game where creativity knows no bounds! Design stunning looks for each month of the year with vibrant eyeshadows, bold lipsticks, sparkling gems, and stylish accessories. Choose between Pro Mode for precision or Freestyle Mode for endless color combinations. Complete your seasonal masterpiece with matching jewelry and hair accessories. Perfect for makeup enthusiasts, this game is your go-to for all things beauty and style! Play now!

title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: Zombie Highway Rampage
description:
Drive your Rhino truck through hordes of zombies in this zombie apocalypse game.

Avoid incoming obstacles such as land mines, bounders, cars and other hazard materials.

Shoot and destroy obstacles with bullets.

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
Hordes of insidious demons are lurking in the hellish catacombs! Can you challenge hundreds of hellish creatures and destroy them all as you descend closer to the citadel?
You have several types of weapons at your disposal and an almost endless supply of ammo along the way!
With each step, collecting gold that falls from enemies, you will become stronger and stronger, strength, speed of movement, arsenal of deadly weapons, armor - all this will depend on your actions.

title: Easter Eggventure
description: Welcome to Easter Eggventure! Embark on an exciting journey to find Easter eggs scattered throughout the beautiful spring landscape. Your mission is to discover the hidden Easter eggs and collect them all. Are you ready for this thrilling search game? Let's get started!

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Biking Extreme 3D
description: Do you like riding a mountain bike? Biking Extreme 3D offers you a chance to ride a mountain bike and challenge multiplayer mountain racing tracks. It doesn't matter when you crash any other riders on the track, they will be crashed into the sky. But please always keep a safe distance between your vehicle and obstacles like trees and rocks. Or else, you will lose the game directly. The coins you won are used to upgrade your bike. Don't forget to try another 5 characters!

title: Dark Academia Wedding
description: Step into a world of moody elegance in Dark Academia Wedding! Help the bride and groom prepare for their enchanting, gothic-inspired celebration. Choose vintage dresses, romantic accessories, and rich color palettes that capture the essence of dark academia. From candlelit ceremonies to mysterious venues, every detail matters. Create the perfect blend of classic romance and intellectual charm in this stylish wedding dress up game!

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Fox Adventure
description:
Is a dynamic endless runner that brings back the spirit of classic arcade games!
Run or Lose! Control a brave fox in a world where danger lurks at every step. Fiery meteors rain down from the sky, and deadly spikes cover the ground. Your reflexes are your best weapon. Jump, dodge, and survive as long as you can!
Build Your Collection Grab gold coins along the way! Visit the shop to unlock unique looks: become a futuristic Cyber-Fox, put on a Clown costume, wear the Royal robe.

title: Huggy Wuggy Guess the right door
description: In Huggy Wuggy -Guess the right door you have to find your way through a maze like factory, choosing the right way. In each room there are 3 doors, but behind one of them you will find Huggy Wuggy. You have to go through 50 rooms if you want to find the exit. Try your best and leave this haunted place as fast as you can!

title: Classic Mahjong
description:
"Mahjong Classic" is a classic mahjong solitaire with a unique algorithm for generating levels - a random layout of chips always has a solution! Each playthrough becomes unique, allowing you to play your favorite fields an unlimited amount of times!
In the game you will find popular fields: Turtle, Fort, Crab, Spider, Cat, Dragon and many others.
Play solitaire at your own pace, there is no time limit!

title: Stunt Fury
description: Stunt Fury takes adrenaline-fueled stunts to new heights in this action-packed gaming experience. Strap in and prepare to defy gravity as you showcase your skills on a variety of daring platforms. With heart-pounding excitement around every corner, this game challenges players to push the limits of physics and creativity.

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Idle Lawnmower
description: In Idle Lawnmower, embrace the tranquility of tending to your virtual lawn, earning gold with each satisfying swath cut. Utilize your earnings to upgrade your lawnmower, enhancing efficiency and earning potential in this idle game of grassy growth and financial gain.

title: Hidden Object Rooms Exploration
description: Explore a variety of rooms and find hidden items! With 18 levels and 6 items to discover in each room, enjoy the thrill of searching through different spaces like living rooms and more. Drag the screen to explore them. Get ready for an exciting adventure in 'Hidden Object Rooms Exploration'!

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: Headless Joe
description: While playing, robot Joe literally lost his head. But it's not as hopeless as it seems. To get it back in place and screw it tightly, Joe needs to solve puzzles and collect all the bolts. But he can’t do this without your help!

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Make Ten Tiles
description: Play Make Ten Tiles free online and sharpen your skills in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Merge number tiles, add to ten, and solve each logic puzzle in a satisfying brain game that blends fun with real mental math practice. This unblocked game loads fast and works smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks and focused learning.

title: Treasure Champion - Chest Capture
description: Dive into the exciting world of stickmen in this exciting team game! Your task is to capture the chest in the center of the field and deliver it to the base together with your team, avoiding traps and tricky moves of your opponents. Each successfully delivered chest brings points, and the dynamics of the game keep you in suspense until the last second.

title: Save The Beauty
description: Save The Beauty is a free online adventure game for kids, which with rich levels, 2D perspective, fresh style, cartoon skin, and a random combination of level challenges that will surely open your eyes. Different levels have different traps, do not let the little sister hurt, or you will have to start all over again. Interested friends come to experience it!

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: Spellmind
description:
Welcome to Spellmind Magic School where wonderful adventures await! Solve match-3 puzzles to restore the old mansion to former glory. Beat colorful levels, explore magic mist-filled rooms, decorate them to your taste and solve the mysteries of the missing wizard’s mansion!
Show that you’ve got what it takes to restore the Spellmind Magic School to its former glory!  Build wonderful interiors for Sabrina’s story to take place in.

title: Holiday Hex Sort
description: In Holiday Hex Sort, drag and drop hex tile stacks onto the board. Merge tiles to form stacks of 10 and collect them. As levels progress, more tile types appear. If there are 10 similar tiles on a stack, they will be collected. Clear all tiles by making stacks of 10 before time runs out !

title: Fast Lap
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed racing with a simple yet challenging touch-controlled game. Navigate a twisting track as you balance speed and control. Accelerate on straightaways, but be careful! Take curves too fast and you'll spin out. Master the art of timing to become the ultimate racer.

title: Cute Coloring Games
description: Cute Coloring Games is a fun drawing coloring game. Filled with fun, colorful and creative drawing tools, coloring games help kids of all ages have fun creating art. Follow the prompts will draw and finish coloring it! Don't forget to share the success with your friends!

title: Zoo Restaurant
description: Run the cutest food business ever in Zoo Restaurant! This addictive restaurant game lets you serve adorable animal customers while building an amazing dessert empire. Keep your hungry customers happy while your business keeps growing! It mixes relaxing merge mechanics with fun Simulation gameplay. Fans of restaurant management games will love the rewarding progression system.

title: Monster School Challenge
description: Complete teacher's assignments for evaluation, finding out who is a Noob and who is a Pro! Different tests and characters are waiting for you in the game Monster School Challenge.

title: Geometry Vertical
description: In Poligon Dash - Geometry, you find yourself entangled in an adrenaline-fueled run against time and various geometric obstacles. This game offers a dynamic mix of speed, calculations, and precision. With each level being a new challenge filled with exciting twists and turns, your journey to the finish line will keep you on your toes

title: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing
description: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing plays like a shoot-em-up car shooting arcade game. With 3D vehicles on the ground, your mission is to defeat the final boss by collecting upgrade items and shooting down vehicles on the ground. Your vehicle will keep shooting automatically. Don't forget to collect the magnet to collect all kinds of items easily. To defeat the final boss, you need to avoid its bullets and keep shooting. Have fun!

title: Angry Chibi Run
description: Angry Chibi RunAn endless sprinting running game. Jump and slide to avoid obstacles and dodge oncoming trains as fast as possible. Choose your favorite character, dress him up and surf the streets to your heart's content! What are you waiting for, come and join the best parkour game ever!

title: Echolocation Shooter
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot. Unleash soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades to light up the battlefield, upgrade your gear, and fight deeper into the horde.

Every shot reveals the world—every wave pushes your limits.

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens, but the monsters are back! Evil Huggy has kidnapped them again!
Now Nubik has new weapons: AK-47, M16, grenade launcher, machine gun, and shotguns!
Help him rescue the kittens, collect loot, earn coins, upgrade, blast TNT, and escape traps. Even his friend gets captured—help Nubik save him too!

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Toca Teens Floating Beach Party
description: The Toca Teens are ready for the ultimate floating party—and they’re counting on your style sense! In Toca Teens Floating Beach Party, your goal is to get everyone dressed in their best summer-ready looks before the fun begins.

title: Neko's Adventure
description: Neko’s Adventure is a vibrant platformer starring Neko, a playful cat trying to rescue his girlfriend. Explore 20 challenging levels, unlock the Power Beam to shoot fire, and face quirky enemies in a whimsical, fast-paced adventure full of charm, excitement, and cartoon fun!

title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
description: Get ready for unbridled automotive chaos in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!– a game where the three elements of extreme driving merge: devastating crash tests, masterful drifting, and frantic racing!

title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation.
