Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Run 3D
description: The infinite running platformer game Run 3D takes place in the immensity of space. The character must be navigated by players through the constantly shifting space. Go, leap, and keep yourself from plummeting into the chasm!

title: Hide and Luig
description: Hide and Luig is a whimsical point-and-click hide-and-seek adventure where your only goal is to find the ever-elusive Luig—who insists on hiding inside the weirdest objects imaginable.

title: Enchanted Easter Adventure
description: Step into a magical springtime world in Enchanted Easter Adventure, where Lily and adorable bunny come together to celebrate Easter! This whimsical game combines storytelling, mini-puzzles, character dress-up, and holiday cheer in one unforgettable journey.

title: Sticker Puzzle Book
description: Step into the captivating world of Sticker Puzzle, where creativity and strategy come together in a beautifully immersive experience. Explore a vibrant sticker book filled with artistic challenges, visual storytelling, and mind-bending puzzles. Designed as a peaceful chromatic retreat, Sticker Puzzle blends the calming satisfaction of sticker art with the engaging thrill of strategic problem-solving — the perfect harmony of relaxation and mental stimulation.

title: Missile Launch Master
description: Experience the thrill of Boom Missile 3D, a 3D simulation game that will test your missile skills. You will play as a missile pilot who must dodge hot air balloons and helicopters in the sky. You will also have to fly the missile over an island and hit the target before the time runs out. Boom Missile 3D is a game that combines stunning 3D graphics and smooth controls. You will feel like you are in the cockpit of a real missile. Can you complete all the missions and destroy the enemy’s base?

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Skibidi Survivor Rush
description:
The exciting 3D game Skibidi Survivor Rush has action, shooting, and evading contaminated skibidi toilets. You may play it for free.

You take charge of a cameraman in this incredible game who must stay one step ahead of the skibidi toilet. Navigate the city map as your character relentlessly shoots at approaching skibidi. For every one you get rid of, you'll get a little something that will boost your level and let you upgrade or acquire new abilities.

title: Ice Cream Fever Cooking Game
description: In this frozen treat game, embark on a delightful journey through a world of creamy concoctions, toppings, and the most scrumptious sundaes you've ever dreamed of. If you're a fan of cooking games and have a soft spot for delectable desserts, "Ice Cream Fever" is the game you've been craving!

title: Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing
description: Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing is a hyper-chaotic, turbo-charged racing game where logic goes to die and only the wildest survive. In a world where speed meets absurdity, you’ll choose from a trio of outrageous racers, strap into your customized Formula car, and blast through tracks so insane they might just melt your brain. This isn’t your average kart racer—this is pure, high-octane brainrot.

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge
description: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge is a wild meme-fueled obby game where you’ll jump, fall, and laugh your way through chaos! Inspired by the viral spirit of Italian Brainrot Animals of TikTok trends, this game turns parkour madness into pure comedy. Take control of the legendary Brr Brr Patapim and conquer ridiculous levels full of traps, platforms, and meme-powered surprises.

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Mergest Kingdom
description: Mergest Kingdom is a merge puzzle and match-3 game where you create your kingdom by combining items in threes. Match resources to unlock new items, complete quests, and grow your land.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Stickman Football
description:
"Stickman Football" is an exciting 2D game where you take on the role of a stick football player and compete against an opponent. Your goal is to score using various moves and tricks.

You have the ability to teleport to the ball after a shot to improve your chances of scoring. This adds a strategic element to the game, as you must choose the right moment to use teleportation to get the ball into the goal.

title: Two Supra Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful supra. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Princesses of Quadrobics
description: Two beautiful princesses, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, are waiting for your help in creating the perfect images for practicing Quadrobics. First, create a gentle but expressive makeup for each of the girls and put your hair in a comfortable hairstyle. Then choose dresses, jewelry and accessories. But the adventures don't end there! Complete the look by putting masks in the form of adorable animals on the princesses. After all, this is a mandatory part of the Quadrobics trend!

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: Pet Tile Master
description: Enjoy a fun pet-themed tile-matching challenge in Pet Tile Master! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring adorable pets and match three identical ones to clear them. Be careful—if the stack fills up with 9 tiles, the game is over! Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles and complete each level. Have fun with cute animals, relaxing gameplay, and tricky puzzles!

title: Puzzle Trails
description: Puzzle Trails is a relaxing sliding puzzle game with colorful image categories, progression maps, rewards, bonuses, and score milestones. Solve each puzzle by moving tiles into the correct order, unlock new categories, collect coins and points, and use helpful bonuses when you need support. The game is easy to play, works on desktop and mobile devices, and offers a calm puzzle experience for players of all ages.

title: SpelunKing
description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive underground, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Upgrade buildings and unlock new facilities as you match deeper! Reach the bottom of the mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description:
“Arrow Escape: Puzzle” is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.

- Short levels you can play in a minute.  
- Focus on logic and move order, not speed.  
- Simple controls: one tap — one move.

title: Cube Connect
description: Move the blocks and guide the ball to the goal. After a period of time, the ball starts to move. Connect the paths quickly so that the ball doesn't fall. Some blocks can jump and some can warp.

title: Ace Car Racing
description: Ace Car Racing offers high-octane city-avoidance action. Choose from sleek 3D modern sports cars across Seaside Roads, Exotic, City Racing, and Desert Trip. Collect lightning items for fuel, coins for upgrades, or splurge on new cars. Remember: diamonds unlock special vehicles. Invest in a superior car upfront and fine-tune its Acceleration, Max Speed, Wind Resistance, and Nitrogen. Skip the starter car—your race to victory awaits!

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Basket Shot
description: Anyone may enjoy the swelteringly popular arcade game Basket Shot! Become the next basketball superstar by shooting baskets and unlocking new balls!

title: Pet Salon Simulator
description: It's a very busy day at the pet salon! Jump in and give our furry friends the full treatment. Wash, groom, and style them to look even more charming and adorable. Show off your grooming skills and create picture-perfect transformations that will make every pet leave feeling proud and confident!

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: Brain Draw Line
description:
Brain Draw Line is a minimalist puzzle game where you must complete shapes using a single, continuous line. There are no timers or unnecessary distractions — the focus is purely on precision and planning. Each level presents a unique figure that you must finish without lifting your finger or mouse and without crossing the line twice.
The experience is calm, strategic, and rewarding — ideal for players who enjoy logic-based challenges.

title: Back 2 School Makeover
description: Embrace the nostalgia and dive into our Back 2 School Makeover game, where you can fashionably express yourself, experiment with stunning looks, and relish into the feeling of heading back to school with style! Embark on a fabulous journey with our character, Amelia, as she transforms from an edgy e-girl to a chic, school-ready fashionista. Revamp her entire look starting with a haircare routine and a new haircut, a complete skincare routine, and a new, school makeup.

title: Brilliant Jewels
description: Brilliant Jewels is a Match 3 game where you can either play against the time or try to pass levels with limited amount of moves. If you are feeling confident, you can also challenge the hard mode on the time attack mode. This game doesn't lack any sparkle!

title: Sticker Jam Peel Off & Match
description: Play Sticker Jam, the ultimate matching puzzle game! Peel vibrant stickers, match colors, and solve fun challenges. Relax and unwind with this unique blend of calming gameplay and brain-teasing puzzles. Perfect for hours of entertainment—start playing now!

title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient arrived with a dirty, pimply face and teeth problems. Help her take care of these issues and showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Beauty Treatment game. After completing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and makeup from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: Crazy Tunnel
description: Crazy Tunnel is a fast-paced, first-person arcade game. Navigate through the tunnel at breakneck speeds and aim for the longest distance possible.

title: Cleaning Simulator
description:
Cleaning Simulator is a very fun simulation game. Although this game is 2D, it restores the shape of objects in real life very well. This game has a total of 12 parts, covering sports cars, technological products, daily necessities, and other elements, which will definitely meet all your
expectations for cleaning games. Want to know more about this game? Come and try it!

title: Qube 2048
description: We present a unique arcade game that combines the dynamic gameplay of Q*bert and the mechanics of 2048!  You start with the number 2 and move across a grid of blocks, doubling its value. The goal is to reach the maximum number by planning your moves and avoiding obstacles.

title: Dreamy Jewel
description: If you put three or more jewel of thesame type together vertically or horizontally, they'll disappear! Special blocks appear when four or more are aligned and erased. Mixing effects when special blocks are crossed with each other!

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Jenny’s Math Puzzle, a fun and brain-boosting online game where logic meets creativity. Arrange number tiles to solve equations, unlock new puzzles, and sharpen your math skills along the way. Play on your phone or computer — every move counts, and every solution brings you closer to becoming a true math master.

title: Fish Sort
description: Sort colorful fish, place them where they belong, and solve fun sea puzzles in a bright underwater game for kids and adults.

title: Grukkle Onslaught
description: Grukkle Onslaught: Defend the blue portal in this thrilling tower defense game! Strategically place towers to fend off waves of enemies and protect your gateway. Master strategy and quick thinking to emerge victorious. Play now and prove your skills!

title: Dark Stones: Card Battle RPG
description: Dark Stones: Card Battle RPG is a strategic card-based battle game set in a dark fantasy world of magic and elemental forces. Assemble a team of humans, orcs, mages, elves, and other creatures to defeat powerful foes, capture their souls, and unlock new powers.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Black Cat Stacking POP
description: Tap tiles to clear them! When you tap a tile, any same-colored tiles next to it will also connect and clear together. Clear a bunch of tiles at once, and a toy mouse will appear to help clear even more! Clear target tiles or tiles that add moves to increase your remaining moves. The game ends when you run out of moves.

title: Cornhole League - Board Games
description: Cornhole League is a thrilling twist on the classic backyard game where you aim, toss, and score your way to victory. Compete in intense matches, join tournaments, and showcase your flair with customizable boards and bags. Explore stunning venues, from cozy backyards to grand stadiums. Perfect your toss and rise to cornhole greatness!

title: Dead Brain
description:
“Dead Brain” puts you in the shoes of a fearless farmer standing between your crops and the undead hordes. With simple controls and intense action, players must strategically use random upgrades to survive each wave and push their limits. 
After each victorious wave, you'll get to choose a random bonus to aid your survival. Gain a new weapon, heal your hero, repair your defenses, or even boost your health!
Are you ready to defend your farm and become the ultimate zombie-slaying hero?

title: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 194 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!

title: DOP: Draw One Part
description:
► Can you see what’s missing? 

What a pretty picture, but don’t you get the nagging feeling that something’s not quite right? What’s the final touch that will make the image complete? 

Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile time and time again.

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
description:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer! 

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows.

title: Greedy Snake : Brain Hole Explosion
description: This is a level based puzzle game where players will transform into a greedy snake and challenge different levels.Players need to make flexible judgments and plan their movement paths reasonably in order to safely eat apples and reach the finish line smoothly, winning the level victory.

title: Tung Tung Sahur Coloring Book
description:
Unleash your creativity with the Italian Tung Coloring Book, a hilarious and surreal coloring experience inspired by the viral Italian Brainrot meme phenomenon. Featuring absurd characters like Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, and Bombardiro Crocodilo, this coloring book offers a unique blend of humor and art.
Each page presents a bizarre and whimsical scene, inviting you to add your personal touch with colors.

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition
description: Challenge your brain with Math Crossword, the perfect mix of logic puzzles and number games! Solve clever math equations in a crossword-style grid by placing the correct numbers into the right spots. Each level sharpens your brain with fun and rewarding challenges that test your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division skills.

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Bubble Pop Fairyland
description:
Bubble Pop Fairyland is an exciting bubble shooter game that’s very highly addictive!
Aim, shoot & pop all the color bubbles using epic blasters to clear the board and win coins!

Bubble Pop Fairyland is a fun and relaxing puzzle game designed to keep your mind sharp at any age.
It also is a perfect brain training and fast solution making game
You will have hours of fun shooting & matching the same colored bubbles!

title: Wave Dash : Geometry Arrow
description: Ride the wave in Wave Dash, a rhythm platformer where each tap steers your arrow through tight corridors. Read patterns in waves, time jumps to music, and beat brutal stages. Build routes with the level editor, share creations, unlock icons, chase ranks, and perfect speed runs. Simple controls, fast restarts—pure focus and flow. Inspired by classic geometry platformers, tuned for dash mastery.

title: Cryptograph
description: This is a fascinating word puzzle game based on cryptograms. In the game, it is necessary to decipher words using numerical encoding. The gameplay is designed for sequential completion of levels, where each level is a quote or motivational saying. The game allows you to train your attention. A great way to have a pleasant time.

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Real Car Parking Simulator
description:
Get ready to test your driving skills in Real Car Parking Simulator. In the parking simulation game, you will face various parking challenges. With realistic controls and detailed environments,you’ll feel like you're actually behind the wheel. From parallel parking to tight garage spaces,
this game offers many parking challenges.

title: Mate in Chess
description:
Solve clever chess-inspired puzzles with simple controls and satisfying logic. Think ahead, move pieces correctly, trap the king, and complete each level in the best possible way.
Every stage is a small brain teaser where one smart move can change everything. The rules are easy to understand, but each new puzzle becomes more interesting as you learn to plan combinations, avoid mistakes, and find the winning solution.

title: Single Line Puzzle Drawing
description:
Sharpen your mind each day with fun single-line drawing puzzles — clever, captivating brain teasers that boost your cognitive skills one stroke at a time. Enjoy a relaxing and rewarding 20-minute mental workout!
Would you like a version tailored for an app store description or marketing banner?

title: Animal Link
description: Animal Link is a puzzle game, the goal is to remove all the squares by eliminating the same pattern. The rules of the game are simple and require a certain amount of observation and quick reaction ability.

title: Draw a path to the finish line!
description: Draw a path and lead your character to the finish line! Use your creativity and planning to avoid obstacles and reach your goal. Whether you're playing on a computer or phone, this fun puzzle game is all about finding smart and artistic ways to win. Great for all ages!

title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
description: Welcome to Flower Fairy Adventure Story, a casual puzzle game that you can play for free. Flower Fairy lost her wings! Embark on an adventure where you solve each tiny jigsaw, dress up your girl in pretty clothes, and pave the way for the Flower Fairy. Practice your observation, logical thinking, and hands-on ability while enjoying the relaxing and captivating puzzle game.

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Thrill Roller Coaster
description: Thrill Roller Coaster is a fun 3D roller coaster simulator game. Press and hold to accelerate forward, your speed and acceleration is fast enough for you to reach the other end of the track. Watch out for the brakes in the middle and drive the roller coaster at breakneck speeds now! Experience speed and passion!

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Color 3D - Bump It Up
description:
The main principle is pretty simple – you are controlling a small ball that is always moving forward.

On your way, there are a few obstacles that you need to get through. There’s a small problem however, because you can only touch obstacles that are the same color as your ball. If you touch an obstacle with a different color, the game ends and you need to start from the beginning.

title: Tower of Fall
description: In the game "Tower Fall," you must navigate a complex tower, collecting coins to purchase various outfits and weapon upgrades, while battling enemy mobs to reach the final level.

title: Chill Clicker
description: Chill Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the Chill Capybara population by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of Chill Capybaras, change the weather, and unlock new skins to make you the coolest Chill Capybara in town.

title: Tower Crush
description: Tower Crush is a tower battle game in which you can customize and build the best tower to destroy your opponents. Release Date      October 2015 (Android)     May 2016 (iOS)     July 2020 (HTML5)  Developer Tower Crush was developed by Impossible Apps.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Secret Galaxy. Match-three
description: "Secrets of the Galaxy" is an exciting match-3 game where you embark on a space journey with pilot Inessa and her faithful robot A.S.K.A. Their ship is damaged, and they are stranded in the depths of the universe. To return home, you must solve engaging puzzles by matching elements and creating powerful combos. Along the way, you will face asteroids, laser traps, space distortions, and other unique obstacles.

title: Cars Merge
description:
Feel the thrill as racing cars zoom by at lightning speed on the track!

Get your hands on these incredible cars and watch them blaze across the raceway. Show off your passion for speed and excitement by collecting them all!

How many will you collect? Play now and find out!

title: Fall Bean 2
description: Fall Bean 2 invites you to a colorful, fun-filled world of races! In this chaotic platform game, your goal is to be the last one standing by outmaneuvering other players. Jump, roll, and leave your opponents behind on challenging courses. Overcome new obstacles in each round to reach the final and claim victory! Compete with friends or players from around the world in non-stop action. Join Fall Bean 2 now and enjoy the excitement!

title: Block Master - Super Puzzle
description: Welcome to a unique puzzle game where logic and strategy decide everything! Experience a fresh take on classic block games! The pieces appear at the bottom, and it’s up to you to decide where to place them. Drag the blocks onto the field, fill horizontal and vertical lines, and clear space for new moves. Every action requires careful planning—can you score the highest points?

title: Tralala La La La italiano
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure! In this game you will have to connect Italian animals. Collect a collection of rare animals, discover new species and create your own virtual zoo!

title: Cake Link Master
description: Cake Link Master is a fun puzzle game where you tap two matching cakes to connect them with a line. The line can turn up to two times but cannot go over other tiles. The game has 120 challenging levels, and the difficulty grows as you play. Clear the cakes, solve the puzzles, and enjoy hours of sweet, relaxing fun!

title: Football Penalty
description: Step into an exhilarating, never-ending penalty challenge! Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. Collect points for every target hit, progress through levels, and improve your football skills. Take part in a big tournament and get more rewards.

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Tropical Cubes 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the cubes to the maximum number 2048 and not to lose. There is a booster in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: Grill It All
description: Grill it all is a cooking-themed match-3 puzzle game. Play as a grill expert, matching identical skewers to complete orders. Strategically arrange ingredients like fish, leeks, and meatballs on grills. Test your observation and speed while using upgrade tools for strategic depth!

title: Serious Bro
description: Defend your base against adorable alien invaders using an M16 Carbine Rifle and frag grenades. Experience a beautiful low poly 3D environment with cute enemies and simple controls for both desktop and mobile.

title: Stealth Master Sneak Cat
description: Stealth Master: Sneak Cat is a fun stealth adventure game that lets you play the role of a cute cat. You will sneak through various missions! Move quietly under the close watch of enemies and surveillance equipment.

title: Ammo Rush Master
description:
Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master!
Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses!

title: Paws & Pals Diner
description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

Are you ready to create the diner of your dreams and make every animal's visit a memorable one?

Join Paws & Pals Diner today!

title: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land
description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Striped Fruit that full of strategy and fun. Here, you'll become a watermelon maker extraordinaire, mastering the art of fruit merge to create the juiciest combinations on the board. As a merge master, you'll tap, drop, and combine fruits in a strategic dance.

The challenge? To reach your way to the top, the first step is to merge 2 melons to create a watermelon - the King of Fruits. Can you merge 2 watermelons to smash them out? Let's check it out!

title: From Nerd to Popular Ballerina Cappuccina
description:
From Nerd to Popular: Ballerina Cappuccina is a makeover and dress-up game that follows a sweet transformation story. Ballerina Cappuccina starts as a shy, awkward girl with big dreams—and it’s your job to help her glow up and become the confident ballerina she’s meant to be.

Style her through each stage with fabulous outfits, stylish hairstyles, and elegant accessories. As you dress her up, she slowly sheds her insecurities and gains the charm and confidence needed to shine on stage.

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Untwist Road
description: Collect cylinders, roll out the road and overcome obstacles in this unique game. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games who like to test their skills and reactions. Try all the features of the game, unlock new levels and beat your records! You only need a few minutes to fully immerse yourself in this exciting game. Try it yourself!

title: Animal Basketball
description: Dive into Basketball: The Power of Moe! Team up with adorable animals, unlock over 100 magical balls, and enjoy physics-powered hoop action. Play through arcade, championship, and mission modes on dazzling courts in this fun and addictive basketball party!

title: Brain Test IQ Challenge 2
description: Ready for the wonderful challenge of your brain power? Brain Test IQ Challenge 2 is here! This is a brainstorming puzzle game that combines drawing, jumping, multiplayer battle, maze escape and other ways to play. Activate your brain in a second! In draw master, underlining guides the character into the correct restroom.

title: Fish Master: Go Fish
description:
You’d think that a game called Go Fish would be based on the classic card game, but you’d be wrong. Fish Master – Go Fish is all about taking your ship to the middle of the sea and fishing until your boat can’t hold any more fish!

There are dozens of different fish types in the sea, and it’s your job to reel them all in! As you catch fish, your library of fish types will fill up, so you’ll always know what’s left to catch.

title: Spot Differences Bird Adventure
description: Spot Differences: Bird Adventure is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you find differences between two bird pictures. Look carefully, tap the changes, and complete each level before time runs out. Enjoy colorful birds, beautiful scenes, and simple controls. Perfect for all ages who love easy and brain-teasing games.

title: Radiant Rush
description: Radiant Rush is a minimalist synthwave drifting game where you control only the car's steering—not its speed. Your goal is to complete increasingly challenging levels while collecting all the datacubes scattered throughout.

title: Bobb's World
description: Bobb's World is an arcade game where you play as Bobb, who is very hungry and wants to eat all the food in the universe! Help him to go from planet to planet to eat all the food.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: C.A.P.
description:
Take to the skies and protect the carrier in this shooter inspired by WW2 dogfights. 
Dodge enemy fighters, protect your aircraft carrier, and blast through waves of incoming planes. 
Remember to come back to the carrier to refuel!
With crisp pixel-art 3D visuals and one-touch controls, this shooter delivers satisfying action perfect for short play.

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is an exciting game in which you have to get a new experience from driving a motorcycle. Experience a sea of adrenaline while riding a motorcycle and passing 30 levels with dizzying and spectacular obstacles.

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Conduct This
description: Conduct This is a cartoon-style free puzzle online game played on PuzzleGame for boys. You need to move the obstacles on the track so that the train can pass successfully. Get coins for passing levels and unlock the beautiful skins of the train. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. I guess it's easy for you. Are you ready to try it now?

title: Number Master
description:
A number elimination game, connect two numbers that are the same or add up to 10, eliminate them!Relax and match in a peaceful bamboo forest. 

If you enjoy logic puzzles like Sudoku, Merge Numbers, Ten Match, or CrossMath, Panda Match Ten is your perfect nature escape. Train your brain, improve your memory, and boost logic—all with the charm of adorable pandas and soothing bamboo forests.

title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
description: Journey into an ancient Egyptian night in Bubble Shooter Pyramid Quest! Match and pop glossy bubbles to climb rising score goals. Fill the goal bar to trigger quick celebrations, then push onward as the ceiling creeps closer. Beat your High score, earn a second chance with a rewarded continue, and watch desert backdrops shift as you progress. Easy to start, hard to master—aim, bounce, and clear your way to legend! Start in Beginner, then unlock Medium and Hard as your score surges ever higher!

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Slingshot Chicken
description: Launch your fearless chicken from a slingshot and smash through unstable pig-filled towers in an endlessly fun physics adventure! With infinite levels and constantly evolving challenges, no two runs are ever the same. Perfect your aim, trigger explosive TNT chain reactions, and watch satisfying collapses unfold as you clear every pig before your shots run out. The fun never stops — how far can you go?

title: Christmas Snowball Arena
description: Christmas Snowball Arena is a 3D stickman snowball IO game. You have to compete with nine other players in collecting snow blocks and making your snowball bigger. The goal is to be the last player standing by defeating and collecting other snowballs. You can also collect blank snowballs that are free for anyone. You can use two power-ups in the game to boost your snowball: one that makes it twice as big and another that makes it twice as fast. If you are looking for some snowball action, try it!

title: Heroes of Match 3
description: Heroes of Match 3 is a delightful puzzle adventure set in a whimsical medieval world. Match sweets in lines of three to create powerful combos and help King Donuttan the Third reclaim his throne.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Challenge your logic and strategy in this exciting puzzle game! Swipe to move the sponge and color every square in the maze with vibrant colors. It might seem straightforward, but don’t be fooled! Each level brings more complex mazes to test your problem-solving skills. Plan carefully, avoid traps, and complete all levels. Sharpen your mind and enjoy victories in this colorful adventure!

title: Papa Buzja
description:
Papa Buzja brings good things home! He feeds the children, brings them books, makes supplies and builds a house. The path will pass through wide fields, dense forest, squelching swamp and high mountains.
Difficultes and adventures await Papa Buzja along the way. 
Whatever happens on the way, remember: the kids are waiting for you!

title: Makeup Studio Glam Diva
description: Glam Diva Makeup Studio is a beauty game for enthusiasts eager to explore the limitless possibilities of makeup artistry. Dive into a world of luxurious lipsticks and dazzling eye shadows to unleash your inner glam diva.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Real GT Racing Simulator
description: "Real GT Racing Simulator" offers the ultimate driving experience for racing enthusiasts. Get behind the wheel of meticulously detailed cars and race on stunningly realistic tracks. Compete in high-speed circuits, fine-tune your vehicle for peak performance, and rise through the ranks to become a true racing legend. This game emphasizes authentic driving physics, customizable cars, and a variety of racing modes—from casual races to full championship tournaments.

title: Squad Assembler
description:
Assemble a cool squad and see who wins!
Combine items to improve the fighters' equipment! Combine weapons and armor, buy loot boxes with new weapons!
You can create cool, unique characters, each of which will have certain skills! Buy parts for your fighters, change their arms, torso, head! Create real cyborgs to defeat the enemy! Merge armor and weapons, increase the levels and characteristics of items. Hire cool heroes who will help you in tough battles.

title: BFFs Luxury Loungewear
description: Get ready to style your way to comfort in the BFFs Luxury Loungewear game! Join the fun with Riri, Elsa, Polka, and Bonnie, each with a unique wardrobe. Choose from jersey cotton, knitted, velour, or silk sleepwear and accessories to create stylish sleepover outfits. Exercise your fashion skills and make every slumber party a plush, luxury affair. This game is perfect for budding fashionistas and dress-up game enthusiasts alike!

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Cyberpunk City Hairstyles
description: Cyberpunk City Hairstyles is a beauty game where you can take hairstyling to a whole new level! Practice your professional haircare routine to transform Emma's frizzy hair into vibrant, edgy masterpieces.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Push Them!
description: Push Them! is a shooting game where your goal is to push the annoying red stickmen to fall into the water.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Frogga
description: Guide Frogga across a busy road in this exciting frogger-style game. Tap to make Frogga jump forward, timing your movements carefully to avoid the oncoming traffic. Each level presents new challenges with faster cars and trickier obstacles, keeping you on your toes. Collect bonuses and power-ups along the way to help Frogga on his journey.

title: Elementz
description: ElementZ is a Match-3 game similar to Bejeweled or Candy Crush. Its particularity lies in giving each color its elemental power, allowing you to trigger different powers of fire (red), water (blue), earth (brown), plants (green), and electricity (yellow).

title: Powerful Punch
description: Ready to let off some steam? Powerful Punch is the perfect game to brighten your day and release your frustrations. Rescue the weak, take down villains, and unleash your spooky punch, sprunky punch, or even a spranky punch in levels filled with surprises and hilarity

title: Balloon Match 3D
description: Relax and enjoy this addictive ballons 3d matching game as you collect items and complete different missions.Your goal is to clear the bubble by finding and matching all ballons before the time runs out!

title: Stickhole.io
description: "Stickhole.io" is a thrilling game with single and two-player modes. In single player, swallow stickman and defeat bosses within time limits. In two-player mode, compete to eat the most stickman, then battle with collected characters. Dynamic gameplay and colorful graphics make it addictive and fun.

title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
description: Sports Basketball is a thrilling 3D basketball game that will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a basketball fan or just love fast-paced Sports games Fun

title: Epic Hero Quest Idle RPG
description:
Conquer enemies, level up heroes, unlock skills in Epic Hero Quest: Idle RPG!

- Battle Through Hordes of Enemies
- Earn Gold and Level Up
- Unlock and Upgrade Skills

Are you ready to embark on the ultimate adventure? 
Join the quest  and become the legendary hero you were destined to be in Epic Hero Quest: Idle RPG!

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.
